}}'''The Party Crasher and Guzma the Destroyer''' (Japanese: '''乱入！！ 破壊者グズマ！''' ''Intrusion!! Guzma the Destroyer!'') is the sixth chapter of the {{MangaArc|Sun, Moon, Ultra Sun & Ultra Moon}} of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga.

==Plot==
{{incomplete plot}}
==Major events==
{{spoilers}}
* [[Gladion]] defeats [[Hau]] and advances to the next round.
* {{adv|Sun}} battles against [[Guzma]] and wins, advancing him to the final round.
* {{adv|Moon}} is revealed to have obtained a {{p|Grubbin}}, a {{p|Mareanie}}, and an {{rf|Alolan}} {{p|Grimer}}.
* Moon and Gladion begin their battle against each other.
{{Adventuresevents}}
{{endspoilers}}
